description_en: Queries the status of the traffic mirroring feature by calling the GetTrafficMirrorServiceStatus operation
description_zh: 调用GetTrafficMirrorServiceStatus接口查询流量镜像功能的状态
name: GetTrafficMirrorServiceStatus

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request is different
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the traffic mirroring instance.

You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
流量镜像所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

Enabled.description_en:
Indicates whether the traffic mirroring feature is enabled. Valid values:

true: Enabled.

false: Not enabled
Enabled.description_zh:
流量镜像功能是否开通，取值：

true：已开通。

false：未开通
